summary: In this lesson, you will launch Mirage and open a CST file containing the solidification calculation results. This file contains the temperature and phase fields saved during the calculation.
actions: In the main PoligonSoft window, click Mirage.
Click Load the file Temperature. You can also use the Ctrl+T keyboard shortcut.
In the file selection window, locate and select the CST file containing the course results, and click Open.
Wait until the file has finished loading.
Check that the model appears in the workspace.
expected: The CST file will be opened in Mirage. The model will appear in the workspace with the temperature and phase fields available for visualization.
